notes.title: PATCH NOTE #1
notes.content:
[h2]Added the ability to disable the microphone death setting:[/h2]

You can now disable this setting both in the multiplayer lobby and when creating a single-player game.

[h2]Fixed microphone sensitivity settings:[/h2]

The microphone is now less sensitive, allowing for more accurate adjustments.

[h2]Changed monster behavior based on microphone noise:[/h2]

Monsters will now react to noise coming from the microphone. The closer the volume is to the Divider Line, the better the monster can hear you. Watch the noise indicator to avoid attracting monsters.

[h2]Fixed internal game bugs.[/h2]

[h2]Fixed the end game screen from the player's client side:[/h2]

The end game screen now correctly displays for all team members.

[h2]Changed death behavior due to noise:[/h2]

Now, only the player who shouts loudly will die, not the entire team.

notes.title: Don't Shout Together is now available!
notes.content:
[h2]Now Available on Steam[/h2]

Hey everyone, Don't Shout Together is now available on Steam.

We listen to your feedback and strive to make your gameplay as comfortable as possible. If you encounter any difficulties or problems, please describe them on the forum or in our Discord channel. We will answer all your questions and help resolve critical issues.

Please note that DirectX12 can be unstable. You should only run it on RTX 40xx+ to generate frames. If you experience crashes, try running the game in DirectX11.

For all other computers, we highly recommend using DirectX11.

It is highly recommended to use an SSD disk, or better yet an M.2 SSD drive, as the game is demanding in this regard.

notes.title: DON'T SHOUT TOGETHER ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

We are excited to present our first text post filled with exclusive information about our upcoming game - Don't Shout Together! Development of this captivating project is nearing completion, and we eagerly anticipate the moment when we can share more detailed information about its release.

Let's briefly explore some key features that await you in the game:

[list]
[*] Multiplayer for 6 players: Gather a team of friends and explore dangerous locations together.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Voice chat and in-game radio communication: Stay connected with your survival comrades in any situation.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Monsters: Over 7 types of monsters await you in various locations, ready to test your nerves and survival skills. You can hide from them in shelters or break away from pursuit, but be cautious - they will relentlessly chase you, attempting to kill.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Exploration: Over 10 objects hidden in darkness await your inspection and exploration at each location.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Various escape methods: Collect items for two escape methods - by car or by calling the police from a phone booth.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Different flashlight modes: Choose between two lighting modes for your comfort and safety.
[*] "SCUFF Beer" for Scuf: Discover a beer that helps you detect monsters and increases your chances of survival.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Gathering Angry Juice: Collect 10 packs of Angry Juice to unlock an achievement.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Puzzles and map exploration: Prepare to solve puzzles and explore unpredictable terrain to find your path to survival.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Huge map with diverse content: Immerse yourself in the world of Don't Shout Together, alive on a vast map ranging from secluded farms to industrial sites. Travel to diverse locations, explore, and encounter new challenges at every step.
[/list]

Don't miss the opportunity to immerse yourself in the atmospheric survival world of Don't Shout Together! Stay tuned for our updates to stay informed of all the news. Unforgettable adventures and trials await you! 🎮✨
